# Production deployment failed midway leaving mixed versions

Users report inconsistent behavior; some requests hit the new version and some the old.

The new release required a DB migration that had not run, so new pods failed their readiness probe and the rollout stalled, leaving old and new pods both serving.

1. Confirm the stalled rollout and failing readiness on new pods
2. Run the pending DB migration as a pre-deploy job
3. Resume the rollout and confirm all replicas become ready
4. Add a migration gate to the deploy pipeline

Error Details
```
helm upgrade failed: 'context deadline exceeded'; rollout status: 3 of 8 replicas updated then stalled; readiness probe failing HTTP 500 on new pods
```

Tags: cicd, deployment, helm, rollout-stalled, migration
